North Carolina 2026 Elections

Voting in 2026 begins on September 4, 2026.

Statewide Primary Election

The statewide primary election is Tuesday, March 3, 2026.

Statewide General Election

The statewide general election is Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026.

Voter Dates and Deadlines

  • October 9, 2026: voter registration deadline.
  • October 15, 2026: in-person early voting begins.
